prompt:
Create ONE beautifully crafted vector map of the publicly known Granada region in southern Spain, from Loja and Granada south to the Mediterranean Sea. This is a geographic illustration, NOT a map of private projects. Native editable SVG viewBox 0 0 1000 650. North up. Landscape composition. Public places to show: Granada, Loja, Nigüelas, Capileira, La Herradura, Motril, Sierra Nevada, Sierra de Almijara, Sierra de Lújar, Sierra de Loja, Vega de Granada, Valle de Lecrín, La Alpujarra, Costa Tropical, Mar Mediterráneo. Geographically sensible relative placement. Granada is northwest of the Sierra Nevada massif, Loja west of Granada, Nigüelas south of Granada at the western foot of Sierra Nevada, Capileira southeast of Granada in the Alpujarra, Motril near the coast east of La Herradura. The coast should form the lower part of the canvas, Mediterranean below it. Leave generous room for the sea.

EXACT USER-REQUESTED PALETTE: full-canvas SOLID background #1a1917. Warm off-white #f8f6f1 for coastline and town labels. Subdued warm stone #b9ad99 and #68655e at low opacity for terrain. Small terracotta #e27a4a town dots. Sea #20201d, softly distinct from land. No other hues, no gradients, no shadows, no textures, no embedded raster.

ART DIRECTION: A refined architect's landscape atlas, beautiful engraved contemporary cartography. Richly varied fine contours following BRANCHING mountain ridges, saddles, ravines and connected valleys, with delicate hachures and quiet negative space. Sierra Nevada elongated east-west, descending south through intricate Alpujarra ravines. Distinct smaller Almijara relief southwest, Lujar near coast, Sierra de Loja in west. Flat open Vega de Granada. Create convincing geographical structure, not abstract decorative curves. Absolutely NO nested oval blobs, concentric circles, rounded island mountains, equally spaced rings, generic sinusoidal contour lines or cartoon mountain icons. Mountain engraving should be intricate but low contrast, elegantly integrated into one landscape. An irregular recognizable Granada coastline with bays and headlands; not a straight zigzag. Sparse fine bathymetric strokes in sea. Clean labels legible over terrain.

TYPOGRAPHY: restrained upright editorial serif for mountain ranges and Mar Mediterráneo; clean sans-serif town names. Small tracked capitals for VEGA DE GRANADA, VALLE DE LECRÍN, LA ALPUJARRA, COSTA TROPICAL. No italics. Correct Spanish accents. Town labels: Granada, Loja, Nigüelas, Capileira, La Herradura, Motril. No crowded labels or overlaps. Granada slightly prominent off-white dot with fine terracotta ring, other towns small terracotta dots. No hub-and-spoke curves. No flight paths, no route network. No architecture pictograms. Tiny unobtrusive north arrow, no scale bar or claim of survey accuracy. No large title block or legend panel.

DELIVER ONE complete map only, no mockup, web page, frame or decorative border. Use editable paths and text, logical groups background, sea, coastline, relief, labels, towns. Font family Georgia for serif and Arial for sans. Full-bleed flat #1a1917 background mandatory. Craft every region differently to avoid a procedurally generated look. Quality should feel like an experienced cartographer's editorial design.
